requests.name: stories-rain-gallery-v1
requests.description: A sheltered old-book arcade on a softly rainy day, plum-brown timber shelves, cream plaster, tall rounded windows with fine rain streaks and a continuous dry pale wood/stone floor. Upper side: bookshop with unlabelled book spines and a recessed counter outside the standing band. Middle opposite side: small travel-photo gallery with abstract landscape frames, no people/photos of faces or bearded characters. Lower side: cosy rain-window tea nook, no tea table or cups because the sprite already includes them. Rain stays beyond glazing, no puddles under feet, no umbrella, duplicate hat or extra guest. One connected interior arcade, not separate room pictures.

requests.name: possibilities-plane-trees-v1
requests.description: A leafy residential cafe street under broad plane-tree canopies, soft cream and muted apricot buildings, copper-green trim. Upper: cafe terrace facade with an empty recessed serving area, no other guests. Middle: quiet roadside lay-by visible only along a far OUTER edge; wide safe pedestrian standing pavement, no police barrier or arrest scene. Lower: open living-room veranda with an empty bookshelf and plain side window for discussing plans. One connected pale stone pedestrian walk, modest ordinary neighbourhood scale. No celebrities, confirmed holiday tickets, packed luggage, sports cars, money or licence duplicates. Tree shadows remain light and soft away from support bands.

requests.name: news-terraces-v1
requests.description: A modest sunny town guesthouse and residential terrace arcade, soft buttery stone, sage palms, curved bay windows and broad cream paving. Upper side: quiet newspaper-reading veranda without any additional paper. Middle side: guesthouse hotel doorway and small recessed reception window, comfortable and ordinary rather than a palace; no wedding decor. Lower side: open cosy home sitting-room balcony with plain walls and an empty small side shelf, no prizes, cash, forms or pencils. Continuous pedestrian floor from first to last, no tall balustrade across the centre. No reporter crowd, celebrity portraits, marriage signs, mansion or winning celebration.

requests.name: woodland-station-v1
requests.description: A coherent small woodland station and dry forest-edge walkway. Upper section: LEFT side open office-window bay, RIGHT side outdoor utility-cabinet/telephone-line pole near foliage; keep these two contexts visually distinct because the original two callers are at separate ends of a phone call. No extra telephone props. Middle section: an open-side cutaway train-carriage bay with simple blue-green window framing only along the outer/back edges; central level wood floor joins the station walkway and stays EMPTY because the original sprite supplies its two benches and seated family. No extra train seats, passengers or wheels across the route. Lower section: a quiet local woodland clearing reached by the same level sandy stone path; no extra sign or litter basket (the sprite supplies their backs and a few specific discarded objects). Do not turn this into a cleanup victory, pristine-restoration campaign or huge junkyard. No readable boards, labels, railway clocks, added trash piles or additional humans.
